shared_analysis.analysis_rationale: The patch in `bfd/elf64-x86-64.c:6719` adds an immediate error check after `bfd_canonicalize_dynamic_reloc(abfd, dynrelbuf, dynsyms)` and returns `-1` when `dynrelcount < 0`. Concrete evidence shows the fix prevents a negative relocation count from flowing into `qsort(dynrelbuf, dynrelcount, sizeof(arelent *), compare_relocs)`. This clearly addresses missing validation of a count/error sentinel before a size/count-consuming API, but the diff alone does not prove whether the resulting flaw is best classified as integer underflow, integer overflow, out-of-bounds access, or another concrete supported type, so `unknown` is the most evidence-backed label.
